proof_nl: Assume that g is nonincreasing on [a,b) in the stated sense. By definition, this means that for all real numbers x and y satisfying a <= x <= y < b, we have g(y) <= g(x). The conclusion of the lemma is exactly the same statement. Therefore, for any real x,y with a <= x <= y < b, one has g(y) <= g(x).
solver_summary: The lemma is an exact restatement of the hypothesis, so the conclusion follows immediately from the definition of nonincreasing on [a,b).
